parameters.name: DefenseScene
parameters.description: The protection scenario. For more information, see the **DefenseScene** parameter in [CreateDefenseRule](~~461421~~).

parameters.name: DefenseSubScene
parameters.description: The sub-scenario of the protection template. This parameter is supported only for advanced bot management scenarios.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the protection template to create.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description:
The name of the protection template to create. The name must be 1 to 255 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

> Template names must be unique within the same protection scenario (**DefenseScene**).

parameters.name: TemplateOrigin
parameters.description: The source of the protection template to create. Set the value to **custom**, which indicates user-defined.

parameters.name: TemplateStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the protection template to create. Valid values:
- **0**: Disabled.
- **1**: Enabled.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description:
The templatetype of the protection template to create. Valid values:
- **user_default**: default protection.
- **user_custom**: custom protection.

parameters.name: UnbindResourceGroups
parameters.description:
The protected object groups to unbind when creating a default protection template. Specify the value in the [**"group1","group2",……**] format.
> This parameter takes effect only when you create a **default template** (the value of **TemplateType** is **user_default**).

parameters.name: UnbindResources
parameters.description:
The protected objects to unbind when creating a default protection template. Specify the value in the [**"XX1","XX2",……**] format.
> This parameter takes effect only when you create a **default template** (the value of **TemplateType** is **user_default**).
